notes.title: Version 1.07 🚀🚀 Mostly not human
notes.notes:
Version 1.07 🚀🚀 Mostly not human

Pulse Beta: Pulse is system That DCF and Chat Bots can use to Play/run the game. Much of the changes in this build are
In the back end, which allows AI extended control of DCF. Because Pulse is not Public facing 
We will not give detailed updates in these read mes. if you have some interest in the AI system contact me/ 

Ramp Collision issue - (buildable ramps had a collision box, fixed)
Parkour Builds Pieces - (Worked through some Parkour elements and made buildable. Jump pad is now buildable and more coming soon)
Misc, there have been a few little things added and changed, but as stated this update was much more for the ai side of things.
